releaseNotes:
## Proxy pool failover
- A dead first pool entry no longer fails the request: the pool rotates to a live entry.
- Requests with a body that cannot be rewound are not resent, so an upstream never sees a truncated payload.

## Provider capabilities
- The models.dev overlay now also covers image output, tools, and reasoning, keyed by provider as well as model.
- The overlay stays additive: a catalogue miss never switches a capability off.

## Dashboard
- Proxy pool entries render as compact cards matching the combo model list.
- Fixed a class-name collision with the settings cards that forced 18px of extra spacing and a divider onto every entry.

---
Update from the dashboard (sidebar button) or run `9router-go --update`.
